create_DirectOptimizer: create a DirectOptimizer instance for planning state trajectories using MuJoCo inverse dynamics
run_DirectOptimizer_optimize: run the DirectOptimizer optimize method to minimize force and sensor cost over a configuration trajectory
build_qpos_to_qvel_qacc: build velocity and acceleration trajectories from a qpos configuration trajectory using finite differences
compute_diff_inverse_dynamics: compute inverse dynamics Jacobians with respect to configuration, velocity, and acceleration
calculate_diff_cost_force: calculate gradient and Hessian of the force cost with respect to qpos and optional parameters
